The following events occurred in '''3969 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[First WatchCircle]] of the [[Jedi Covenant]]&mdash;[[Feln]], [[Lucien Draay]], [[Q'Anilia]], [[Raana Tey]], and [[Xamar]]&mdash;are assigned five [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]: [[Oojoh]], [[Zayne Carrick]], [[Shad Jelavan]], [[Kamlin]], [[Gharn]]. The five Padawans are transferred to the [[Jedi Tower]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where their new [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] are stationed.<ref name="KOTOR 24">[[Knights of the Old Republic 24|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 24]]</ref>
